args.text:
Fixed-limit hold'em strategy (A03):
1. Play tight from early position: strong pairs, big broadway cards, suited connectors only in late position.
2. Raise/bet strong hands for value; don't slowplay much in fixed limit.
3. Fold weak hands facing a raise out of position; call with pot odds when drawing (flush/straight draws with good odds).
4. Bluff sparingly, mainly on dry boards when checked to heads-up in position.
5. Respect aggression: if an opponent raises repeatedly, assume strength unless they have shown weakness.
6. Track each opponent's tendencies (folds to raises, bluff frequency) and exploit loose-passive players by value betting thinner.
7. Late game: check the points standing and adjust risk accordingly.
